security.title: Security
security.intro: Configure a temporary code compatible with TOTP applications.
security.totpHelp: TOTP is a temporary six-digit code that changes every 30 seconds in an app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 2FAS. In addition to the password, sign-in will request that code or a recovery code.
security.linkHelp: The previous configuration remains valid until you confirm this new key.
security.qrAlt: QR code to configure two-factor authentication for this account
security.scanQr: Scan it with your authenticator app. If you cannot, use the manual key below.
security.stepOne: Open an authenticator app and scan the QR code or choose to add an account manually.
security.stepTwo: Use the time-based type, six digits and a 30-second period.
security.stepFour: Enter the generated code to confirm.
security.recoveryHelp: They are shown only once. Each code permits one sign-in.
security.activatedMessage: Two-factor authentication enabled. Save the recovery codes now.
security.codesCopied: Recovery codes copied. Store them outside the browser.
